comment: Offline-first OpenStreetMap integration contract for the Nuxel Maps app. Shipped as data so the map surface (pwa/nuxel-apps/maps) and the GNSS diagnostic agree on ONE tile layout, ONE attribution and ONE offline story. This file describes the layout; it does not ship map data (that is owner/area work), and the app must render cached tiles with the radio off.

network.user_agent_note: An honest HTTP User-Agent is required by the OSM tile usage policy; the app must degrade to cached tiles when offline, never to a blank grid without a message.

offline_first.comment: The launcher/Maps app must load a cached area with the network off. A map that only works online is not offline-first and must be labelled as such in the UI.
